Title: Tanay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Tanay - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anjali - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Aditya - 11 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
4. Siya - 11 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "What lovely weather!"

[Tanay opens his umbrella.]

Anjali: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay puts on his raincoat.]

Anjali: "Okay, Tanay."

[The rain stops.]

Tanay: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Tanay: "Mom, look over here."

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Tanay: "Hmm, I see."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Tanay: "I knew it!"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Tanay: "This is amazing!"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Tanay: "Okay, Mom."

[Tanay lights a bonfire.]

Tanay: "I really enjoyed today."
